candidate_contract.priority: an enabled sanitized accessibility inspection candidate remains authoritative whenever one exists
candidate_contract.fallback_scope: current-screenshot visual fallback is evaluated only while an exact-field target-row detail is active and the accessibility route produced zero inspection candidates
candidate_contract.visual_affordance: three compact dark components must be vertically aligned, near-circular, similar in area and dimensions, regularly spaced, and located inside a top or bottom toolbar band
candidate_contract.pixel_boundary: the detector performs no OCR and persists or routes no screenshot pixels, crops, task text, row title, field value, or answer candidate
candidate_contract.candidate_payload: only the generic label vertical ellipsis, source class current_screenshot_shape, normalized bounding box, and normalized center are routed
candidate_contract.tap_binding: an active-detail tap is permitted only when its normalized coordinate hits the exact controller-observed candidate bounding box
candidate_contract.failure_policy: missing or malformed screenshots and images without a high-confidence ellipsis fail closed with zero candidates
candidate_contract.read_only_policy: Back, answer, typing, arbitrary exploration, selector changes, and Save-class controls remain forbidden until exact existing requested-field text is visible

coverage: the frozen r69 live terminal screenshot yields exactly one generic visual inspection candidate
the recorded initial blank tap is still blocked and receives the current-screenshot candidate in its bounded repair
the recorded repair tap at normalized coordinate 0.405,0.925 is independently grounded by current pixels
an accessibility More options candidate prevents visual fallback evaluation
a blank screenshot yields zero visual candidates
the candidate and repair contain neither the visible row title nor requested-field value
historical r69 package validation fails closed after future-head source drift

add exact-source freeze, prerequisite, and invocation-boundary tests

launch any formal r70 Gate-F batch
run any r70 development sequence other than its single frozen H17 M0 cell

route screenshot text or pixels into the decision prompt
